test_contract.summary: There is no AuditDecision decorator and no AUDIT_RECORD_* constant anywhere in the tree. The test's real contract: a mutating handler (post/put/patch/delete decorator) passes if it reaches an audit writer within 4 call hops, or if (module, handler) is a key in NOT_AUDIT_WORTHY or AUDIT_DECISION_OWED in test_audit_provenance.py.
test_contract.detection: _reaches_an_audit_writer(): name-based AST call walk, depth <= 4, over every source module

audit_decorator_catalog.note: Card language says 'decorator'; the tree has none, and adding one would not satisfy the AST guard, which detects calls, not decorators. The catalogue therefore specifies the required _audit_log call parameters.
audit_decorator_catalog.writer: api_compat._audit_log(executor, tenant_id, event_type, agent_id, agent_name, actor, detail)
audit_decorator_catalog.caller_actor: Principal.email or Principal.subject from a FastAPI dependency (require_superadmin / authenticated_principal). Never a literal, never a module constant, never a request field.
audit_decorator_catalog.tenant_id: The environment's customer_hash (8 lowercase hex), which is the tenant key these EAP modules already use. audit_events.tenant_id is TEXT NOT NULL.
audit_decorator_catalog.action_event_type: One of the new_event_types below; each must be added to a NEW migration 045 that drop-and-recreates audit_events_event_type_check with the full 040 vocabulary (50 values) plus these, and CONSTRAINT_MIGRATION in test_audit_event_types.py must be repointed to 045.
audit_decorator_catalog.executor: PostgreSQL-backed routes: the same connection/transaction as the state write (thread it through LifecycleManager). In-memory routes: the api_compat pool, plus a RECORDS_A_NON_DATABASE_ACTION entry stating ordering (audit first, act second).
audit_decorator_catalog.detail: Server-observed values only (record id, resulting expires_at, extended flag, actions_count). Webhook payload fields are HMAC-attested client claims and need ACCEPTED_CLIENT_SUPPLIED_FIELDS entries if they reach detail.

remediation_rules_for_p3_1: No wildcard, prefix, module-level or pattern exemption. Each NOT_AUDIT_WORTHY key is one (module, handler) tuple with a reason true of this tree.

Do not weaken or repoint any detection in test_audit_provenance.py. The only allowed test edits are the two NOT_AUDIT_WORTHY entries, the RECORDS_A_NON_DATABASE_ACTION / ACCEPTED_CLIENT_SUPPLIED_FIELDS entries named above, and repointing CONSTRAINT_MIGRATION to the new last migration, which the comment in test_audit_event_types.py itself requires.
Migration 045 must carry the full 040 vocabulary (50) plus the new types. 040, not 038, is the last migration that recreates audit_events_event_type_check today.
Done means test_audit_provenance.py and test_audit_event_types.py both fully green, and the full offline suite back to 0 failed.

collisions_and_findings.summary: EAPR-P2-1 (c7a7084cd574c54f969016562d491c4f6b9d510d, contained in integration/eapr-v0.1.0 e3f516b1fdde94978187bd864af9dcd94205461a) is NOT an ancestor of this base and edits all five modules plus test_audit_provenance.py (+72 lines). It adds NOT_AUDIT_WORTHY entries for all 13 of these routes.
collisions_and_findings.consequence: When the two integrations meet, those entries will either textually conflict with P3-1's changes or, if they merge cleanly, sit beside P3-1's audit writes and fail test_the_not_audit_worthy_list_has_no_stale_entries. Several of the EAPR reasons are false against this tree: 'in-memory lifecycle state' (it is PostgreSQL here), and 'emit structured ReaperAuditEvent' (ReaperAuditEvent does not occur anywhere in this tree). EAPR-P2-1 also adds authenticated_principal to these routers, which is the actor source P3-1 needs.

collisions_and_findings.summary: 9 of 13 routes have no auth dependency (live app.routes dependant check). Anyone who can reach the API can provision or tear down environments and tenant isolation boundaries, and seed synthetic evidence.

test_audit_event_types.CONSTRAINT_MIGRATION points at 038 (43 types), but 039 (48) and 040 (50) both recreate audit_events_event_type_check later. It stays green only because host_enrollment and external_agent_registration emit through private writers the extractor does not read.

AUDIT_DECISION_OWED declares ('signal_fusion.py','promote_actor') twice (the later value silently wins), and run_correlation / seed_collectors appear in both NOT_AUDIT_WORTHY and AUDIT_DECISION_OWED with contradictory rulings.
record_heartbeat uses `extend_minutes or 60`, so extend_minutes=0 extends the lease by 60 minutes.

The card names main.py, api_compat.py and host_enrollment.py as route homes and AUDIT_RECORD_* classifications. The real homes are environment_lifecycle.py, environment_routing.py, scenario_seeding.py, tenant_isolation.py and webhook_triggers.py, and no AuditDecision type exists.
